title: Home Delivery Transit Schedule for Dose Changes — Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit
content:
**Schedule.** For a dose-change override under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, the days of a Home Delivery Pharmacy shipment run from its delivery rather than its shipment:

| The fill being re-dosed is | Its days start |
|---|---|
| A shipment sent by standard shipping | The Home Delivery Pharmacy program's standard shipping time in business days plus 2, counted as calendar days, after the shipment date |
| A shipment sent by two-day, overnight or cold-chain shipping | 2 calendar days after the shipment date |
| A retail fill | On its date of service |

The shipping method is read from the shipped Home Delivery Pharmacy order, and the standard shipping time is the figure the member's Home Delivery Pharmacy program sets.

## Applied (hypothetical shipments)

- A standard shipment on June 3 under a home delivery program whose standard shipping time is 5 business days: 5 plus 2 gives 7, so the days start on June 10.
- An overnight shipment on June 3: the days start on June 5.
- A cold-chain shipment on June 3: the days start on June 5.
- A retail fill with a date of service of June 3: the days start on June 3.
